title.zh: 【MSCI 确认非经营性公司不纳入全球可投资市场指数，数字资产持仓公司适用新方法】
title.en: 【MSCI 确认非经营性公司不纳入全球可投资市场指数，数字资产持仓公司适用新方法】

current_state.zh: MSCI confirmed it will exclude non-operating companies, including digital-asset treasury firms, from its Global Investable Market Indexes starting November 30, 2026, retiring its earlier interim treatment for crypto-heavy balance sheets, with a final affected-constituent list due November 11.
current_state.en: MSCI confirmed it will exclude non-operating companies, including digital-asset treasury firms, from its Global Investable Market Indexes starting November 30, 2026, retiring its earlier interim treatment for crypto-heavy balance sheets, with a final affected-constituent list due November 11.
